in_sanskrit.name: राघवी
in_sanskrit.meaning: Ruler of the Cosmos, Ruler of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Raghavi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Raghava’, which means ‘Ruler of the Cosmos, Ruler of the Earth’. In Hindu mythology, Raghava is a name of Lord Rama, an incarnation of God Vishnu. Raghavi is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
